items.title: Will Hearts prove credentials at scene of title heartbreak?

items.title: O'Neill defiant in defeat, but Celtic's 'flat-track bullies' fail another big test
items.summary: Celtic have now lost two Europa League group games, as well as two derbies - but Martin O'Neill is adamant he can see positive signs.

items.title: Why Celtic fans keep returning to Lisbon nearly 60 years on
items.summary: As the club returns to the Portuguese capital to face Benfica, fans have once again made the journey to the Estádio Nacional, where the Lisbon Lions made football history in 1967.

items.title: Celtic fan banned for two years over Shankland gesture
items.summary: Liam Connolly, 37, entered the Celtic Park pitch after his side were victorious against the Edinburgh club on 16 May.

items.title: Jota comeback helps Celtic lift gloom in strong response
items.summary: Jota's comeback from long-term injury and Celtic's convincing victory over Motherwell provide positivity following the club's recent acrimony.

items.title: Decision to stay at Celtic did not take long - O'Neill
items.summary: Martin O'Neill suggests he was never close to leaving Celtic after a three-game losing streak, with the veteran manager stressing his "great enthusiasm" for the role.

items.title: 'Not Celtic' - O'Neill condemns Desmond protest
items.summary: "This is not Celtic at all," is manager Martin O'Neill's response to the rising tensions between sections of the fan base and the club's board.

items.title: Inside the £1-an-hour official football shirt factories
items.summary: A BBC Sport investigation traces official football shirt production to factories in Cambodia where workers are paid less than £1 an hour.

items.title: O'Neill 'just as determined' to lead Celtic

items.title: Born into Celtic, made at Motherwell, Welsh comes of age with Scotland

items.title: Fans group questions Desmond's priorities amid Celtic protest row

items.summary: Kevin Hill's much-loved Celtic top was lost years ago but that was just the start of an international mystery.

items.summary: After vanishing under mysterious circumstances, Kevin Hill's prized Celtic strip embarked on a trip across the globe.
